component.name: ProbeList
component.script:
sub init() m.top.focusable = true m.focusedIndex = -1 m.top.observeFieldScoped("prefix", "build") m.top.observeFieldScoped("focusedChild", "onListFocusChange") end sub
sub build() m.buttons = [] for i = 0 to 2 b = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ProbeButton") b.id = m.top.prefix + i.toStr() m.buttons.push(b) end for m.top.appendChildren(m.buttons) end sub
sub onListFocusChange() fc = "invalid" if m.top.focusedChild <> invalid then fc = m.top.focusedChild.id print "PROBE|" + m.top.prefix + "List focusedChild=" + fc + " hasFocus=" + m.top.hasFocus().toStr() if m.top.hasFocus() = true index = m.focusedIndex if index < 0 then index = 0 focusButton(index) end if end sub
sub focusButton(index as integer) m.focusedIndex = index m.buttons[index].setFocus(true) end sub
function onKeyEvent(key as string, press as boolean) as boolean if not press then return false stepBy = 0 if m.top.prefix = "h" if key = "left" then stepBy = -1 if key = "right" then stepBy = 1 else if key = "up" then stepBy = -1 if key = "down" then stepBy = 1 end if if stepBy = 0 then return false target = m.focusedIndex + stepBy if target < 0 or target > 2 then return false print "PROBE|key " + key + " -> " + m.top.prefix + target.toStr() focusButton(target) dump("after-" + key) return true end function
sub dump(label as string) scene = m.top.getScene() line = "PROBE|state " + label for each id in ["h0", "h1", "h2", "v0", "v1", "v2"] line = line + " " + id + "=" + scene.findNode(id).hasFocus().toStr() end for print line end sub
